model_annotation:
The line graph shows the F1分数 (F1 score) of three models, lattice, FLAT, and OURS, over 16 epochs. 

The x-axis is labeled "epoch (次)" and ranges from 0 to 18, with a linear scale and numerical tick marks at intervals of 2, starting at 2 and ending at 16.

The y-axis is labeled "F1分数" and ranges from 0.55 to 0.90, with a linear scale and numerical tick marks at intervals of 0.05, starting at 0.60 and ending at 0.90.

The graph displays three lines: a red line representing lattice, starting at approximately (2, 0.60) and ending at approximately (16, 0.85); a blue line representing FLAT, starting at approximately (2, 0.80) and ending at approximately (16, 0.87); and a yellow line representing OURS, starting at approximately (2, 0.83) and ending at approximately (16, 0.90).
